paper_cards.title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
paper_cards.data: 75 hours of simulated VR teleoperation across six scenes; 1–2 real hours per task on a 56-DoF bimanual system.
paper_cards.method: 222M causal diffusion transformer with long history and short action chunks, simulation pre-training, and full real-task fine-tuning.
paper_cards.novelty: On-embodiment simulated collection avoids both hardware cost and retargeting loss.
paper_cards.evidence: Official project reports better progress than scratch BC on all five tasks.

claim_checks.claim: 75 hours collected by five operators in one week
Five autonomous real tasks improve over scratch

paper_cards.limitations: Not zero-shot; no language; one embodiment; code/data links absent.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Simulation data recipe for contact-rich dexterity and history-aware control.

paper_cards.title: Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them
paper_cards.data: Almost 2,500 real rollouts across five contact-rich tasks.
paper_cards.method: FACT combines a low-noise-emphasizing schedule with temporal force encoding and timestep modulation.
paper_cards.task: Diagnose and fix precision and force failures in flow-based VLAs.
paper_cards.novelty: Separates two causal failure modes and targets each without extra demonstrations.
paper_cards.evidence: 66% average success versus 41% best prior baseline.
paper_cards.limitations: Primarily pi-family policies, five lab tasks, wrist force sensing, no independent reproduction.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Contact-physics failure taxonomy and action-policy validator.

paper_cards.title: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
paper_cards.data: Real demonstrations/evaluations for heterogeneous two- and three-robot collaborative tasks.
paper_cards.method: One pi0.5 backbone trained on pooled per-robot tuples and independently deployed with local observation plus robot identity.
paper_cards.novelty: Shared weights induce teammate modeling without inference communication.
paper_cards.evidence: Reports +64 points over decentralized scratch, +40-point reactivity, and 90% on a three-robot task.

claim_checks.claim: No shared observation or communication at inference

paper_cards.limitations: Small teams/tasks, closed backbone, no safety/deadlock guarantee.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Multi-agent action and identity schema reference.

paper_cards.title: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
paper_cards.data: Small real policy rollout batches, DROID regularization data, and generated synthetic rollouts.
paper_cards.method: Alternates policy deployment, failure-rich world-model adaptation, synthetic rollout generation, and VLA updates.
paper_cards.task: Co-improve a VLA and learned video simulator under limited real interaction.
paper_cards.novelty: Repairs the simulator on the deployed policy's failures before using it as policy data.
paper_cards.evidence: Reports +39.2 absolute points over base policy, including +11.6 from generated rollouts.
paper_cards.limitations: Sparse public project surface, real rollout dependency, reward-label risk, limited tasks.

paper_cards.title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
paper_cards.data: 16 tasks, 1,600 training demonstrations, fixed validation/test splits, public models and datasets.
paper_cards.method: Four memory suites plus 14 pi0.5-based symbolic/perceptual memory variants.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory in manipulation.
paper_cards.novelty: Standardized executable taxonomy revealing task-dependent memory design tradeoffs.
paper_cards.evidence: Official benchmark, code, data, models, videos, leaderboard, and interactive demo are public.
paper_cards.limitations: Simulation-only, one primary substrate/backbone, RL spawning incomplete.
